title: 目標達成の後に・かすかな芽生え

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto, yet to become race-ready, has been working hard day after day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But will this benefit her in the long run? I need to make a decision, and soon.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Quietly… without making a sound… Okay, the coast is clear. All right, time to say my goodbyes…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I already know… how things are to turn out. I've been nothing but trouble since my debut.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you've done so much for me. You treated me kindly, and that made me happy. But now, I must find a way on my own.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm not forgetting anything, am I? I already put the leftover snacks and photo frame in my bag…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eek, who's there?! Trainer and… Fukukitaru?!
choice_data_list: Where do you plan on taking all of that?
Where do you plan on taking all of that?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, well… I'm not needed anymore, right? So, I thought I should…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Keep"? You don't mean…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?! You mean I can stay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Of course you can stay, Doto! You've been steadily accumulating good karma.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The gods have their eyes on you! That goes for your trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Ummm… Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I've messed up countless times, and yet you've never given up on me. So, I'll give you double the effort from here on. Ngh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, we get back to training. Gradually, I begin noticing a change.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thump, thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… How was that?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooh, your form was almost unrecognizable! Th-this is a harbinger of good comings, no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Has the time finally dawned upon us?! What was it called? The…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The pray-ready state!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Race-ready… Does this mean my body is finally getting stronger?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, I have felt lighter on my feet recently. Maybe I can start pushing myself more.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So… what should be our next goal?
choice_data_list: Shall we try entering the Derby?
Shall we try entering the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! The Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-th-the graded races are scary enough, but G1 races are the scariest of them all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-w-well if you insist, I'll happily do it. Especially because I'm r-r-race-ready… now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Now… Nownownow—Na?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Nyaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doto, hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She crumbles under the potent mix of enthusiasm and anxiety. It might be best to save the G1 for later.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eghh… Sorry about that…
choice_data_list: Let's focus on building up a bit more experience.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ye-yeah… I still have a long way to go if just the name alone makes me panic.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I think you're making good progress, though. Perhaps, if possessed by the god of courage…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Physically, she's been showing signs of growth, but emotionally, she isn't keeping up. It's still best to hunker down and make gradual progress.
